message.content: {"choice":39,"reason":"Ставка на лицензию даёт ожидаемый доход 20–60 alashi при сохранении основной части cash."}
message.reasoning_content: License income 20-60 alashi, big value. Bid high, e.g. 15-20. But winning bid goes to bank (which gets distributed anyway weighted). Competitors rich: 37.8 and 7.9. To outbid 37.8 needs everything. But then I'm broke. Bid 20M likely wins vs rival with 37.8? They might bid more. License income expected ~40 alashi = 40M units, worth it. Bid 20M, keep cash. Also can still produce after? Bid doesn't consume action, but only one candidate chosen. Choose bid 20M.
